title: GISMap Online map spec (map-v1)
description: A whole map as one JSON object: layers with styles and filters, linked chart panels, basemap, look and camera. Open it at https://gismap.online/#map=json:<URI-encoded JSON> (written by hand, up to 8 KB), as the compressed #map= form from mapSpec.createLink, or host the file and open https://gismap.online/?spec=<https URL>. Invalid parts are skipped and reported; the rest of the map still opens.

title.description: The map's name, shown as the project title.

description.description: What the map shows, for people reading the spec.

basemap.description: The background map. gray-vector and dark-gray-vector keep attention on the data; the open-* basemaps are OpenFreeMap styles (MapLibre engine; ArcGIS draws the nearest match); skin draws it in the colours of the interface skin (with the MapLibre engine; the ArcGIS engine uses the light or dark gray canvas).

skin.description: The interface look. It never changes a layer's style; with the skin basemap the map is drawn in its colours, and with the MapLibre engine layers that have no style take its accent colour.

camera.description: Where the map looks. Default { "fit": "layers" }: fit the loaded data (its dense core when it spreads over half the world).

fit.description: "layers" fits the data; "none" keeps the starting view.

zoom.description: Zoom level (about 4 = a country, 10 = a city).

scale.description: Map scale denominator, instead of zoom.

heading.description: Compass direction the camera faces, in degrees.

tilt.description: 0 looks straight down; higher values look toward the horizon.

underground.description: The underground view: the ground fades (groundOpacity 0 hides it, 1 keeps it solid) so layers with subsurface show below it. true is { enabled: true, groundOpacity: 0.45 }.

layers.description: The data, drawn in order (the last is on top). At most 10.

analysis.description: Spatial analysis the browser runs after the layers load. Each result is added as a layer.

input.description: A position in layers (0 is the first), or GeoJSON.

overlay.description: A position in layers, or GeoJSON. Required by overlay operations.

charts.description: Chart panels opened beside the map when the link opens, each linked to one of the layers: colours follow the layer's map style, hovering a mark highlights its features and clicking zooms to them. Only the definition travels (type, fields, layer, look, placement); the numbers are computed from the layer in the browser. The sidebar is left as it is. A chart that cannot be drawn (unknown type, missing field, its layer did not load) is left out and reported.

briefing.description: Optional slides that present the map, as a briefing-v1 document (https://gismap.online/schemas/briefing-v1.schema.json). Its layerId may be one of the layer URLs.

url.description: HTTPS URL of an ArcGIS REST layer or service (FeatureServer/0, MapServer, ImageServer), a GeoJSON file, or a WMS/WFS/KML service. Public only: no tokens or keys. The service must allow browser (CORS) access. Append ?f=pjson to an ArcGIS URL to see its fields.

type.description: The layer type; arcgis-auto detects it from the service, and from .las/.laz/.xyz (pointcloud) or .glb/.gltf/.obj/.ply (model) file extensions. pointcloud and model draw with three.js on the MapLibre engine.

title.description: The name shown in the Layers panel and legend.

where.description: A read-only SQL filter on the layer's fields, such as "CORN_SALES_IN_DOLLARS >= 0" or "STATE = 'Iowa'". No statements, comments or semicolons.

renderer.description: The style. Field names must match the service exactly; a misspelled field keeps the service's own style and is reported.

scene3d.description: Options for pointcloud and model layers (MapLibre engine, drawn with three.js). Elevations are real heights in metres after unit conversion, not virtual Z.

crs.description: The data's coordinate system: EPSG:<code>, a proj4 string or WKT. LAS/LAZ files usually carry it; XYZ files and CAD models in projected coordinates need it.

colorBy.description: Point colours; auto uses RGB, then ASPRS classification, then elevation.

maxPoints.description: Larger clouds are thinned evenly to this many points.

classes.description: Show only these ASPRS classes, such as [5, 14] for high vegetation and conductor wires.

animate.description: Reveal the points from lowest to highest on the shared animation clock.

anchor.description: Model placement: [longitude, latitude, altitude in metres].

heading.description: Model rotation clockwise from north, in degrees.

upAxis.description: glTF is Y-up; many CAD exports are Z-up.

heightReference.description: ground (default): heights above the data's own ground level, placed on the terrain; absolute: surveyed elevations as they are.

animatedEffect.description: Decorative animated effect drawn on the layer's features (MapLibre engine; other engines show the layer without it). It is visual annotation, never data. auto picks one from the layer's title, geometry and fields; pulse sizes rings by a magnitude field and wind follows direction/speed fields when present.

field.description: The numeric field a Rise (extrude) or Reveal reads; chosen from the layer when absent.

subsurface.description: Draw the layer below the local ground (MapLibre and ArcGIS engines): lines as pipes, cables or tunnels, points as wells, shafts or manholes hanging from the ground, polygons as rock units or basements between a top and a base. Seen in the underground view, which fades the ground. Depth is real metres below the terrain, times exaggeration.

depth.description: Down from the local ground to a pipe's centre, a unit's top or a well's bottom. Default 3 m.

field.description: A numeric field; features without a value use meters.

scale.description: Field units to metres: 0.3048 for feet, 0.0254 for inches.

thickness.description: Polygons: a unit's top to its base. Default 20 m.

field.description: A numeric field; features without a value use meters.

scale.description: Field units to metres: 0.3048 for feet, 0.0254 for inches.

diameter.description: Lines and points: a pipe's or shaft's width. Default 1 m.

field.description: A numeric field; features without a value use meters.

scale.description: Field units to metres: 0.3048 for feet, 0.0254 for inches.

minMeters.description: Display floor so small pipes stay visible. Default 1 m.

exaggeration.description: Vertical exaggeration of depth and thickness. Default 1.

color.description: One colour for everything below ground; without it features keep the layer's style colours.

spatialChart.description: 3D spatial chart settings (MapLibre and ArcGIS engines). Z values are display offsets, never physical altitude. source-footprints/none is the fast display strategy and does not calculate exact polygon overlaps. terraced-surface (MapLibre only) smooths height.field into a surface and stacks it as terraces cut at groups, the ascending lower bound of each terrace; its surface object sets the weightField, bandwidthKm, cellKm, classes and smoothing.

order.description: Stacking order from the bottom up. "descending" puts the highest group at the bottom; "listed" stacks groups in the order given, first at the bottom, for values that do not sort, such as geologic ages.

reversed.description: With order "listed": the listed groups were flipped by Reverse stacking order. groups is already in stacking order, first at the bottom.

groundOutlines.description: Also draw the flat layer outlines on the ground under the stack.

surface.description: terraced-surface only: how the surface is smoothed.

weightField.description: A numeric field, such as population, that weights each polygon's value. Default: area.

bandwidthKm.description: Kernel width. Wider is smoother, with fewer islands. Default: about the spacing between polygons.

cellKm.description: Grid cell size. Default: picked from the layer's extent.

classes.description: Terraces, at equal-area breaks, when groups is not given.

smoothing.description: Rounds of corner cutting on the terrace edges.

visible.description: Whether the layer starts switched on.

ignoreServiceScaleRange.description: Draw at every zoom level, even where the publisher hides the layer (its minScale/maxScale).

refreshInterval.description: Reload the layer every this many minutes (for live feeds).

fields.description: Fields to feature when a feature is inspected.

popup.description: Fields of interest for inspecting features.

chart.description: One chart panel, at most 4,000 characters of JSON. Field names only: no records, values or credentials.

type.description: bar, column and donut compare categories; line and area show a trend over a date field; histogram bins one numeric field; kpi is one headline value.

title.description: Shown on the panel. Default: the measure and dimension, such as "Count by POOState".

layer.description: The layer to chart: its position in layers (0 is the first, the default) or its url.

dimension.description: The field to group by (categories, or dates for line and area). Required except for histogram and kpi.

measure.description: The field to aggregate, as a name or { field, aggregation }. Leave it out to count features.

aggregation.description: Shorthand for measure.aggregation. Default: sum with a measure field, count without.

scope.description: filtered follows the layer's where and map filters; viewport follows the view.

style.description: How the chart looks; it never changes the numbers.

palette.description: inherit uses the layer's map colours; theme the interface skin; neon the futuristic palette.

theme.description: futuristic is the HUD look; auto uses it under the violet-circuit, velvet-orbit and wavelength skins.

topN.description: How many categories show; 0 shows all. Default: the chart type's own (16 for bar).

other.description: The categories beyond topN: grouped as one Other mark, or left out.

hidden.description: Category labels left out of the chart.
